own_solution.law: For charging from an initially uncharged state, V_C(t) = E[1 - exp(-t/(R_total C))]. The base time constant is (5000 Ω)(20 × 10^-6 F) = 0.100 s, so V_C(0.080 s) = 12[1 - exp(-0.8)] = 6.60805243 V.
assumptions: The battery is an ideal constant-voltage source, and the capacitor and resistors are ideal.
Any added series resistor is present from the initial connection.
Wires and closed switches have negligible resistance.

TABC4.regime: The observation occurs before the circuit opens: 80 ms < 500 ms.

T2215.regime: The observation occurs before battery disconnection: 80 ms < 500 ms.

notes: Each relevant resistor sentence adds 2 kΩ to the existing 5 kΩ, giving a time constant of 0.140 s and voltage 12[1 - exp(-4/7)] V. The disconnected resistors have no physical path to the target. The switching events occur after the requested measurement. All resistor variants consistently specify 2 kΩ, and both switching variants consistently specify 500 ms; their wording and attachments introduce no unintended numerical differences.
